title: Project P.I.T.T. Secret Ending Guide — END?, Elevator Code & Route
description: Reach the END? secret ending and find your save-specific elevator keypad code; 2640 is not a universal fix.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Secret Ending Guide — END?, Elevator Code & Route
quickAnswer: END? is the Secret Ending; the route ends at an elevator that requires a save-specific keypad code assembled from four discovered digits — 2640 is not universal.

facts.label: END? meaning
facts.value: END? is the Secret Ending, distinct from the main END! conclusion. It’s unlocked by the secret route and concludes at the elevator keypad rather than the standard ending path.

facts.label: Route
facts.value: The secret route gathers four digits in this discovery order: Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly. Completing those steps brings you to the elevator for END?.

facts.label: Code
facts.value: The elevator keypad code is save-specific and constructed from the four digits you discovered in that save. Do not assume a universal code—2640 is not guaranteed.

facts.label: Next if the code fails
facts.value: If the code fails, confirm all four digits were found in this save and in the correct order, and that Anomaly Phase 4 is completed. For full 2640 troubleshooting see the Elevator Code guide; also consult the Troubleshooting and Percentage Pipe pages if needed.
